# CODAP Data Interactive Plugin API

> How a web page running in an iframe inside CODAP (Common Online Data Analysis Platform) — a
> plugin — reads and changes CODAP's data, components and document, and receives notifications,
> by sending JSON requests over iframe-phone. This describes CODAP v3; where v3 still differs
> from the v2 contract, each page lists the difference under Known limitations.

Start with the index for the request and response envelope, resource selectors and the default
data context. Each resource page is self-contained.

## Overview

- [Index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/README.md): what plugins are, terminology, request and response shape, ids, names that are not part of the API, the default data context, and the list of resources
- [Notifications](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/notifications.md): every notification CODAP sends to plugins, and when
- [Quick reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/quick-reference.md): generated tables of actions per resource, the selector grammar and the error messages
- [Request JSON Schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/plugin-api-request.schema.json): a generated JSON Schema for request envelopes

## Guides

## Resources

- [adornment, adornmentList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/adornment.md): A graph's measures and overlays: means, box plots, least-squares lines and the like
- [allCases](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/all-cases.md): Every case in a collection, or delete every case in a data context
- [attribute](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/attribute.md): One attribute: its name, type, formula and display settings
- [attributeList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/attribute-list.md): The attributes of one collection
- [attributeLocation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/attribute-location.md): Move an attribute within its collection or into another one
- [case](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case.md): Create cases, or update several at once
- [caseByID](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case-by-id.md): One case, found by its id
- [caseByIndex](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case-by-index.md): One case, found by its position in a collection
- [caseCount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case-count.md): How many cases a collection has
- [caseFormulaSearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case-formula-search.md): The cases in a collection for which a formula is true
- [caseSearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/case-search.md): The cases in a collection that satisfy a simple comparison
- [collection, collectionList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/collection.md): One level of a data context's hierarchy
- [component](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/component.md): A tile in the workspace: graph, table, map, slider, text and the rest
- [componentList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/component-list.md): Every component in the document
- [configuration, configurationList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/configuration.md): Settings that change how CODAP behaves for the document
- [dataContext](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/data-context.md): One data set: its collections, attributes, cases and metadata
- [dataContextFromURL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/data-context-from-url.md): Create a data context from a CSV file on the web
- [dataContextList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/data-context-list.md): Every data context in the document
- [dataDisplay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/data-display.md): A rendered image of a graph
- [document](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/document.md): Read or replace the whole document
- [formulaEngine](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/formula-engine.md): CODAP's formula functions, and evaluating formulas
- [global, globalList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/global.md): A global value, such as a slider's
- [interactiveApi](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/interactive-api.md): Whether CODAP is running inside a host learning platform
- [interactiveFrame](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/interactive-frame.md): The plugin's own tile: its title, size, saved state and behavior
- [item](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/item.md): Create, read, update and delete items
- [itemByCaseID](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/item-by-case-id.md): The item behind a case, found by the case's id
- [itemByID](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/item-by-id.md): One item, found by its id
- [itemCount](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/item-count.md): How many items a data context has
- [itemSearch](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/item-search.md): The items that satisfy a simple comparison
- [logMessage](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/log-message.md): Write an event to CODAP's log
- [logMessageMonitor](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/log-message-monitor.md): Be told about the events CODAP logs
- [selectionList](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/selection-list.md): The selected cases in a data context
- [undoChangeNotice](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/concord-consortium/codap/main/v3/doc/plugin-api/resources/undo-change-notice.md): Take part in CODAP's undo history
